Per `AGENTS.md` and `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, which uses this exact feature as its worked example, these files change. Nothing has been modified. I confirmed the symbol locations against the code index. I did not open the route mounts at `index.ts:41-48`, so that line range comes from the recipe doc.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add a `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` type next to `LevelUpBody:168`. Add a cost constant such as `INN_COST`, next to the other rule constants (`XP_THRESHOLDS:175`). The cost lives in the Worker because the Worker owns gold and HP. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with a `POST /`. It validates the body and calls `getCharacter` (`services/character.ts:86`). It returns an error if `gold < cost`. Otherwise it calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`:94`, whitelisted fields only). It returns `{ updatedCharacter, ... }`. Optionally it also calls `askDM` for narration, then `appendHistory` and `saveSession` (`services/session.ts`), and inserts an `adventure_log` row, following `routes/action.ts`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` (mounts at `:41-48`) | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. The CORS block at `:19-35` needs no change because no new origin is involved. |
| `worker/src/services/*.ts` (optional) | Move any logic that more than one route would share here instead of keeping it in the route. |
| `worker/migrations/000N_*.sql` | Not needed, since `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` already exist. If a schema change is wanted, add a new migration and never edit `0001`. |

## Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse` interface that mirrors the Worker response. Place it near `ActionResponse:95` and `CombatResponse:106`. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)`, which posts to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. Place it near `levelUp():74`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `rest()` handler, modelled on `levelUp():183`. It calls the API, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` (`character-state.service.ts:50`) so the sheet updates, and pushes a system or narrative entry. It handles the not-enough-gold error. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn (N gp)" button wired to `rest()`. Disable it when `gold < cost` or when combat is active. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy. |

`character-sheet` and `character-state.service.ts` need no change, because they react to `setCharacter`.
